correctness.rationale: The claim is mathematically correct. For row generators Q with off-diagonal rates >=0, Q1=0 and spec(Q) in Re z<=0; the Radau denominator zeros 2±i√2 are excluded so r(hQ) exists, and r(0)=1 preserves row sums. Exact expansion r(z)=1+z+z²/2+z³/6+z⁴/36−z⁵/108+O(z⁶) implies each reachable off-diagonal entry has a positive leading term a_d(Q^d)_{ij}h^d at shortest path length d<=4 in n<=5; unreachable entries vanish identically and diagonals start at 1. For the given six-state absorbing birth chain, independently reconstructed nilpotent Jordan functional calculus yields all five candidate c_0..c_4 expressions and all five absorbing b_1..b_5 identities, with b5=h5 P(h)/D(h)^5. All c_0..c_4 and b_1..b_4 are nonnegative on [0,3]; P is strictly increasing for h>0 and has unique positive zero alpha in (1/4,13/50). For (0,alpha), b5<0, for [alpha,3] all entries nonnegative, and for h>3 c0=2(3−h)/D<0. Independent SymPy exact simplification and independent rational 6x6 inversion at h=1/10,1/4,13/50,1,3,4 confirm the identities, row sums, signs, and alpha≈0.253946561637298. No finite extrapolation is used for universal n<=5 or exact interval.
